reserveReview.rationale: The current USD1 proof-of-reserves adapter exposes one aggregate U.S. Treasury Bills, Money Market Funds & Cash slice. The May 31 Crowe examination provides the latest reviewed underlying split of 85% government money-market fund and 15% demand deposits, but the live aggregate is retained as one exact source-native row rather than pretending the adapter provides a current constituent split.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material unclassified reserve exposure is present in the examined report; individual deposit banks and the money-market fund's current underlying positions are not enumerated in the USD1 report.
